# treetracker-web-map-client

Machine-generated documentation for [`Greenstand/treetracker-web-map-client`](https://github.com/Greenstand/treetracker-web-map-client),
the Greenstand Treetracker Web Map: a Next.js/React web app that renders an interactive Leaflet
map of tracked trees, planters, organizations, and wallet/token data. It uses Material UI 5 and
Keycloak/OIDC sign-in.

## Business domains

- **Map Exploration**: the interactive tree map. It shows tree clusters, zooms in and out, and opens a tree page after a click. It runs in the desktop, mobile, and embed layouts.
- **Entity Profiles**: detail pages for trees, captures, tokens, planters, organizations, and wallets.
- **Search and Discovery**: keyword search, the date filters, and the Tree Spotlight page with the country leaderboard. The layouts hide the search bar, so the search page opens only by URL.
- **Sharing and Embedding**: share a tree, token, or capture page by link, email, Facebook, Twitter, or embed code, and run the map in embed mode inside another site.
- **Authentication and Admin**: OIDC sign-in through Keycloak (the code hides the sign-in controls today), and the admin pages for the navbar, logo, map, and theme.
